title: The cpu turn queue does not receive a computer continuation job
description:
As a household member, I want computer-required continuations kept off the cpu SQS queue, so that a computerless worker is not invoked until a computer-capable worker exists.

Feature: Computerless turn

Scenario: Resume does not publish a computer job to the cpu queue
  Given an empty control plane with a cpu enqueue hook
  And tenant anthus user ryan has a channel with a named bot Assistant
  And tenant anthus user ryan household computer is stopped
  When user ryan of tenant anthus posts a browser request addressed to Assistant
  And a counting computerless worker processes bot Assistant
  And tenant anthus user ryan household computer is running
  And user ryan of tenant anthus resumes that waiting turn
  Then the continuation job requires computer
  And the cpu enqueue hook was not invoked for that job
  And the turn remains active

Not included: Fargate, a second SQS queue, staging or production.

comments.author: home
comments.text: ThinTurn-only development deploy from develop @ e7d4ba1. Named exercise --environment development exits 0 (claim 404, second claim 409, mid-stream CloudFront reconnect, waiting, resume-while-stopped 409). Computer continuations are not published to the cpu SQS queue; computerless refuse remains defense in depth. Not staging, not production, not --all.
